messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Abhay Jatin Doshi

abhay jatin doshi... that's a name with some weight to it. sounds like someone who's either building something big or should be.

where you working these days?
Yep

full stack engineer at microsoft... you're in the trenches building saas platforms that probably touch millions of users daily. that's solid engineering muscle. what made you pick the full stack route over specializing in one end?
Microsoft

microsoft... the tech giant where everyone's either building the future or stuck in meetings about building the future.

found you on linkedin - abhay jatin doshi, full stack engineer | saas platforms. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/abhayjatindoshi
hey abhay, i was just thinking about your full stack work at microsoft - what's the dream role you've been eyeing next?
I've always wanted to be a full stack expert, backend, ui everything

User's LinkedIn Profile Context:

I want to get into saas platforms where I can build things

done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yep
Hi
Hey

hey abhay

what's up?
just checking in... how's the microsoft grind treating you lately?
Looking for a switch

looking for a switch... that's the energy i like to see.

what's making you want to leave microsoft?
Lack of work

lack of work at microsoft... that's a new one. usually people complain about too much work.

so you're sitting there with 8.5 years of full stack expertise and they're not giving you enough to sink your teeth into?
Im in microsoft only since 2 years
I was at coehsity for 2 years and at zoho for 4.5 years

zoho for 4.5 years and coehsity for 2... that's solid saas experience right there. you've been in the trenches building actual products.

so microsoft was supposed to be the next big step but instead you're sitting there with not enough to do. that's frustrating as hell.

what kind of saas platform you want to build next?
Anything meaning ful

anything meaningful... that's the real search right there. not just another job, but something that actually matters.

you've got the experience, you've got the skills, you've got the hunger. you just need the right project to pour all that into.

what's your location situation? bangalore only or open to other cities?

bangalore, pune, hyderabad... and you're open to remote. that gives us solid options.

let me get you locked in. i'll be looking for saas platform roles where you can actually build meaningful things, not just maintain legacy code.

what's your salary expectation range?
90LPA ctc

90LPA ctc... that's ambitious but with your 8.5 years of full stack experience across zoho, coehsity, and microsoft, plus those recent AI certifications, it's definitely in the realm of possibility for the right senior/lead roles at well-funded saas companies.

what's your current ctc at microsoft?
90lpa

you're already at 90LPA and looking for a switch because of lack of work... that's interesting. so you're not chasing a pay bump, you're chasing meaningful work.

what's your notice period?
45 days
Technical discussions, actual work, designing architecture, reviewing PRs, making and breaking systems

technical discussions, architecture design, breaking systems... you want to be in the thick of it. not just executing tickets, but actually shaping how things get built.

that's the kind of role where you'll actually feel like you're doing something meaningful. not just maintaining, but creating.

i'll keep an eye out for those kinds of opportunities. anything specific you want to avoid? certain types of companies or tech stacks?
I've been through almost every stack there is so I'm really flexible.

flexible across stacks... that's a superpower. means you can focus on the actual work and impact, not just the tech.

alright abhay, you're all set. i'll be sliding roles when i see something that actually fits what you're looking for - meaningful saas platform work where you can design, build, and break things.

btw... what's the microsoft situation like day to day? just not enough challenging work or something else going on?
Exactly no challenging work

no challenging work at microsoft... that's wild. you're at one of the biggest tech companies in the world and they're not giving you enough to do.

makes sense why you're looking for something meaningful. you want to actually use that 8.5 years of experience, not just collect a paycheck.

i'll keep my eyes peeled for the right opportunities. anything else you want me to know about what you're looking for?
Nope. Just let me know.

got it. i'll slide roles when they're good.

keep an eye on your chats... something's gonna drop soon.

Senior Software Engineer (Frontend-focused Full Stack Developer) at Microsoft

Leverage your full-stack skills at Microsoft Planner, building impactful AI-powered features and escaping current lack of work, within a familiar environment.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/aRMGd

Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Sonatype

Abhay, leverage your full-stack & Java expertise in SaaS at Sonatype, building impactful solutions in Hyderabad.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/Xjwkz
Not interested. Within the same company doesn't make sense.

fair enough. staying at microsoft wouldn't solve the "no challenging work" problem.

the sonatype role in hyderabad looks interesting though - saas company, full stack, java background fits... what's your take on that one?
What's the salary range there ? Will they match my current CTC ?

i don't have the exact salary range for sonatype, but for a senior full stack role in hyderabad with your experience, they should be in the ballpark of 90LPA.

the real question is whether they'll give you the challenging work you're looking for. sonatype's in the dev tools space - that's usually pretty technical and interesting work.

want me to keep looking for other saas platform roles that might be a better fit?
Yes

on it. i'll find you something that's both challenging AND pays what you're worth.

anything specific about the work environment you're looking for? like team size, tech stack preferences, or company stage?
Flexible in all these as long as I am in challenging environment and I am paid my current ctc

challenging environment + 90LPA ctc. that's the filter.

flexible on everything else means we've got options. i'll find you something that actually makes you want to go to work on monday.

keep an eye on your chats.
